title: GRIP Service — Verify Request
description: HTTP request body for POST /v1/verify. Submits an IaC artifact for verification. The service internally decomposes the artifact into resources, runs the full GRIP loop (GROUND → VERIFY → ACT) for each, and returns a flat list of findings.

Artifact.description: An Infrastructure-as-Code artifact submitted for verification. The service must understand the artifact format to parse resources, resolve references, and apply the appropriate verification backend.

format.description: IaC format of the artifact content. Determines which parser and verification backend the service uses.

content.description: Raw artifact content (YAML, HCL, JSON, etc.).
